DB.description: Cloudflare D1 database for task state, subscriptions, and articles.

RAW_BUCKET.description: Cloudflare R2 bucket for raw/refined transcript checkpoints and uploaded audio.

PROCESSING_WORKFLOW.description: Cloudflare Workflows durable execution engine for the transcription and refinement pipeline.

CONTROL_AUTH_USER.description: Username for Basic Auth protecting the /manage control plane and control APIs (required for workers.dev or without Access).

CONTROL_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Password for Basic Auth protecting the /manage control plane and control APIs.

REFINER_API_KEY.description: API key for your OpenAI-compatible Refinement Provider (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Qwen, etc.).

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with Contents: Read and write permissions on your manuscript repository.

GITHUB_OWNER.description: GitHub username or organization owning the manuscript repository.

GITHUB_BRANCH.description: Branch in the manuscript repository (default: main).

GITHUB_PODCAST_PATH.description: Directory path for manuscript Markdown files in the repository (default: podcasts/transcripts).

TRANSCRIPTION_SERVICE_URL.description: Endpoint URL for self-hosted Transcription Service (required if TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER is self-hosted).

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: Cloudflare Access Service Token Client ID for the transcription service hostname.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Cloudflare Access Service Token Client Secret for the transcription service hostname.

DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.description: Alibaba Cloud DashScope API key (required if TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER is dashscope).

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID for presigning custom audio upload URLs (optional).

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: R2 Access Key ID for presigning custom audio upload URLs (optional).

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: R2 Secret Access Key for presigning custom audio upload URLs (optional).
